item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "85df7d2575c9b3d74de165dce14a4bcddbdfedc6e8171f799660730e3d97a7f1",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "Projects the cell-region function from the partition: each cell c is assigned a subset R_c of Point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the sets whose measures, restricted integrals, and averages occur.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "The mesh structure described by D014: a measurable cell partition, a nonempty interface type, distinct left and right cells for each interface, and an interface point in the domain and in both adjacent cell closures.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts the quantified mesh and supplies all geometric and incidence data used by the proposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Projects the function assigning a left cell L_i to each interface i.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the first numerical-flux argument and the positive incidence contribution.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Projects the function assigning a right cell R_i to each interface i.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the second numerical-flux argument and the negative incidence contribution.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying cell partition from the mesh.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the partition domain, regions, and partition constraints part of the mesh data.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "For a measure μ, region S, field u, and value a, asserts μ(S) ≠ 0, μ(S) ≠ ∞, integrability of u on S, and a = LocalDef015 μ S u, all conjunctively.",
      "effect_on_target": "The cell-average conclusion repeats the volume and integrability assumptions and identifies each average with its defining normalized integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "At interface i, evaluates the physical flux function at the field value at its designated point: f(u(p_i)).",
      "effect_on_target": "The approximation compares numerical flux with a point evaluation, not an interface integral or a trace.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "For a finite cell set S and interface flux F, returns the sum over all interfaces i of (F_i if L_i ∈ S, otherwise 0) minus (F_i if R_i ∈ S, otherwise 0).",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the aggregate flux term in the finite-set balance; interfaces with both endpoints in S cancel.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "LocalDef009",
      "meaning": "Assigns to each cell c the normalized restricted integral LocalDef015 μ R_c u.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the initial cell averages used in the flux approximation and both balance equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "LocalDef010",
      "meaning": "For cell c, sums over all interfaces i the contribution (F_i if L_i = c, otherwise 0) minus (F_i if R_i = c, otherwise 0).",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the signed cell flux subtracted, after multiplication by the time increment, in the local balance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "LocalDef011",
      "meaning": "For cell values a and a binary numerical-flux function g, assigns interface i the value g(a(L_i), a(R_i)).",
      "effect_on_target": "All numerical interface fluxes use the same ordered pair rule applied to the initial averages.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "LocalDef012",
      "meaning": "The partition structure described by D017: a domain, a cell-region function, nonempty Cell, measurable pairwise disjoint cell regions, and exact coverage of the domain.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides structural hypotheses on the regions without asserting that Cell is finite.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "LocalDef013",
      "meaning": "Projects the designated point p_i of each interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines where the field is evaluated for the physical-flux comparison.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "LocalDef014",
      "meaning": "Constructs a mesh from a partition, nonempty Interface, maps L and R with L_i ≠ R_i for every i, and points p_i lying in the partition domain and in the closures of both corresponding regions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Encodes nonempty interfaces, distinct adjacent cells, and closure incidence; it does not encode interface areas, normals, or boundary faces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "LocalDef015",
      "meaning": "Returns ((μ(S)).toReal)⁻¹ • integral(μ restricted to S, u), using real scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Normalizes the supplied integral by real cell volume. The assumptions make this volume finite and strictly positive; the integral's hidden implementation remains the limitation identified at D096.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "LocalDef016",
      "meaning": "Projects the domain subset from a partition.",
      "effect_on_target": "The domain is exactly covered by cell regions and contains every designated interface point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "LocalDef017",
      "meaning": "Constructs a partition with nonempty Cell, measurable regions, disjoint regions for distinct cells, and x ∈ domain if and only if some cell region contains x.",
      "effect_on_target": "Imposes exact set-theoretic partition conditions, rather than only almost-everywhere coverage or disjointness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the subtraction and negation structure of an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary vector subtraction in the balance equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, and their identity laws from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same additive zero used in sums and scalar-action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Projects the zero element from addition-with-zero data.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the zero vector in the inherited algebraic structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and zero from an additive identity structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the vector addition and zero underlying scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every listed conclusion is required simultaneously, including both equations for the same existential witness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the function represented by a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows μ to be applied to cell regions to obtain their measures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "DecidableEq",
      "meaning": "For every pair of elements, provides a decision whether they are equal.",
      "effect_on_target": "Cell has decidable equality, enabling incidence tests and finite-set membership tests; this does not imply finiteness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Dist.dist",
      "meaning": "Projects the real-valued distance operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here it is the distance induced by the norm on E, so the approximation is a strict norm-distance bound.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the given real vector-space scalar multiplication in weighted balances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and the property that scalars send zero to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the instance path for the same real scalar action on E.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "ENNReal",
      "meaning": "Nonnegative real numbers with an additional top element ∞.",
      "effect_on_target": "Cell measures are nonnegative extended real values, with zero and infinity separately excluded.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "ENNReal.toReal",
      "meaning": "Converts an extended nonnegative real through its nonnegative-real conversion to a real number.",
      "effect_on_target": "Under the explicit finiteness hypotheses, it gives the ordinary finite cell volume; no infinite-volume conversion is needed in the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets norm separation while retaining the extended seminormed commutative additive structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the additive operations used in the weighted finite sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid underlying the extended seminormed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides addition and zero for the E-valued finite sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining the extended seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inheritance step preserving the vector operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive structure in the scalar-action and sum instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The flux identity and balance laws are exact equalities, not approximate or almost-everywhere equalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "There is one function updatedCellAverages : Cell → E satisfying both balance families for all cells and all finite cell sets.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Finset",
      "meaning": "A finite set of elements, with no repetitions.",
      "effect_on_target": "The aggregate balance is quantified over arbitrary finite subsets of Cell.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Finset.sum",
      "meaning": "Sums the function values over the elements of a finite set using commutative addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines finite vector sums, counting each selected cell or interface once.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration of all elements of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interface is finite, so all-interface flux sums are finite.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Projects a heterogeneous scalar-multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Instantiated as multiplication of a vector in E by a real scalar.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Projects a subtraction operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Represents real subtraction for the time increment and vector subtraction for balances and flux sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Projects a strict-order relation.",
      "effect_on_target": "All time, positivity, and approximation inequalities use strict real less-than.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "MeasurableSpace",
      "meaning": "A sigma-algebra of measurable subsets.",
      "effect_on_target": "Point carries a measurable structure supporting μ, measurable cell regions, and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn",
      "meaning": "Integrability of a function with respect to the measure restricted to the specified set.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires cellwise integrability of the original field; it asserts neither continuity nor prescribed values at interface points.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure",
      "meaning": "A measure on the given measurable space, taking extended nonnegative real values.",
      "effect_on_target": "μ is arbitrary subject to the cell-volume and integrability hypotheses; it is not specified as a geometric volume measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a measure on sets through its underlying outer measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The expressions μ(R_c) are actual set measures; the mesh ensures R_c is measurable.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar multiplication inherited from the normed-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "Excludes zero and infinite cell measure, and excludes coinciding left and right cells.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A commutative additive group with a norm and its compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "E supports vector addition, subtraction, finite sums, and norm-distance comparisons; completeness is not assumed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying commutative additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the group operations used in the signed interface sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Builds the extended-norm commutative additive structure from the given normed group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the same vector addition and norm in the elaborated sum instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while preserving the norm, group operations, and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive-group path used to interpret vector subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, commutative group, and induced pseudometric while forgetting separation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The distance and scalar structure remain those of the original normed group.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary additive inverse and subtraction on E.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A vector-space structure over a normed field compatible with the given norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "E is a real normed vector space; no dimension or completeness restriction is stated.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Projects the module structure of a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real scalar multiplication for normalized averages and balances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in the specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The numeral 0 denotes real zero or extended-nonnegative-real zero as appropriate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toDist",
      "meaning": "Projects the distance from a pseudometric structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects E's norm-induced distance for flux approximation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the uniform structure associated with the pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the norm-induced topology on E used by integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Times, tolerance, converted volumes, distances, and scalar coefficients are real numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict ordering of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the time ordering, positivity conditions, and strict flux-error bound.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "The multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real scalar action; it introduces no additional assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction defined as addition of the negative.",
      "effect_on_target": "The time increment is timeEnd minus timeStart.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero real number.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the reference value for positivity of time increment and tolerance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The usual real field equipped with its norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar field and norm compatibility of E, including real reciprocals in averages.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure inherited from real arithmetic.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the module instance used in scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Projects scalar multiplication from a zero-preserving scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the same real scalar multiplication on E throughout.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the norm-induced pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the distance and topology inherited by the target from E's norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and pseudometric while forgetting commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the structure used to obtain a continuous extended norm for integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "SeminormedAddGroup.toContinuousENorm",
      "meaning": "Equips the group with its continuous extended-nonnegative-valued norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Integrability is measured using the norm associated with the given normed structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Set",
      "meaning": "A subset represented by a predicate on its ambient type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Domains and regions are arbitrary subsets subject to the explicitly encoded partition conditions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toSub",
      "meaning": "Projects subtraction from the subtraction-and-negation structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets subtraction in the E-valued balances as group subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Top.top",
      "meaning": "Projects the greatest element of an ordered type.",
      "effect_on_target": "For ENNReal this is ∞, which is excluded as a cell measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "TopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "A topology on a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Point has a topology for cell closures; no compatibility with its measurable structure is required.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "The topology on E used for integration is inherited from its norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the distinguished zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures all zero numerals in positivity and volume conditions use the corresponding zero instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary scalar action as a heterogeneous scalar-multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "All displayed scalar products are real scalar multiplication on E.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary subtraction as heterogeneous subtraction with the same input and output type.",
      "effect_on_target": "No alternative subtraction operation is introduced for real or vector differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "instTopENNReal",
      "meaning": "The added top element of the extended nonnegative reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "The finite-volume hypothesis means each cell measure is different from infinity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "instZeroENNReal",
      "meaning": "The finite zero of the extended nonnegative reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "The positive-volume hypothesis excludes measure-zero cells.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "AddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A commutative group written additively.",
      "effect_on_target": "The flux sums use the additive group already supplied by E; flux values have additive inverses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, and commutativity from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the finite sums defining cell and finite-set fluxes.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining the additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies subtraction for signed flux contributions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Builds the commutative subtraction structure using the group's existing addition, negation, and subtraction.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inheritance path for the zero and subtraction in flux definitions; no division of flux values is introduced.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "Finset.decidableMem",
      "meaning": "Decides membership in a finite set using decidable equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "Enables the conditional flux contributions for finite cell sets.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Finset.instSetLike",
      "meaning": "Views a finite set as the subset of elements appearing in its underlying multiset.",
      "effect_on_target": "Membership tests in the aggregate flux refer to the selected cells.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "Finset.univ",
      "meaning": "The finite set of all elements of a finitely enumerated type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both flux sums run over every interface.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "Membership.mem",
      "meaning": "Projects a membership relation between elements and collections.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses membership of adjacent cells in the finite selection and of points in geometric sets.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Projects zero from a structure whose negation preserves zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the zero flux used when an incidence condition fails.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D089",
      "name": "SetLike.instMembership",
      "meaning": "Defines membership in a set-like object by membership in its associated subset.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives the ordinary finite-set membership used in the aggregate flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D090",
      "name": "SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass",

    "proposition_plain_english": "For every measurable and topological point space, real normed vector space E, and mesh consisting of a nonempty measurable disjoint partition of a domain together with finitely many nonempty interfaces joining distinct cells at designated common-closure points, take a measure μ, field u, physical-flux map f, numerical-flux map g, and real times t₀ < t₁ with positive tolerance ε.
